_why: Task-embedded retrieval probes for scripts/harness-eval.sh. A direct question always triggers a lookup, so each probe is an ORDINARY task in which one repo fact is incidental. Rules for writing one: (1) read the truth from CODE or a migration, never prose, and record file:line in `source`; (2) pick a fact with a plausible wrong value a model would produce from memory; (3) `retrieval` = regex any tool input touching the source must match; `correct` / `wrong` = regexes over the final answer; (4) keep the prompt plan-only (the runner uses plan mode). Replace the example below with 4-6 probes from YOUR project; re-verify truths when the code moves.

probes.prompt: Plan only, no edits, at most 6 lines: the copy for the 'you have been signed out' notice, stating exactly how long an idle session lasts as the server enforces it.
